name: Signed X
source: One day our heroine, Marty, arrives uncharacteristically early to school to find a boy from another class leaving flowers on her desk. She hides before he can see her, not wanting the situation to become awkward. How will our nutty, hopelessly romantic, manga-loving protagonist deal with the situation?
translation:
一天，我们的女主角玛蒂反常地早早来到学校，却发现另一个班的男孩正在把花放到她的课桌上。她不想让情况变得尴尬，便在男孩发现她之前躲了起来。

这个古怪又无可救药地热爱浪漫漫画的主角会如何应对？
